CustomField.label: Max Levels Above Account Owner
CustomField.description:
★R9 How many managers above the Account Owner the chain may climb. requirement.md says two, which makes a three-level chain: Account Owner, their manager, that manager's manager.
Raising it is how the business buys another level without a deploy — up to four, because Event_Invitee__c pre-provisions five Approver_N__c fields and the approval process five steps. Above that it costs metadata: another field, another step, another permission set entry.
0 means the Account Owner is the only approver, which is a legitimate configuration and not a broken one.
